newsitem.title: CHINA: FORECAST-China industrial output seen up in May.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-China industrial output seen up in May.

text.p: China's industrial output is forecast to increase by about 12.0 percent year-on-year in May to total 178.6 billion yuan, the State Information Centre said in a forecast reported by the China Securities newspaper.
It forecast industrial output would average growth of 11.7 percent for the first five months of the year, totalling 806 billion yuan.
China's industrial output from January to April was worth 625.0 billion yuan, up 11.4 percent compared with the same period of 1996, the State Statistical Bureau said.
Industrial output in April alone was worth 174.3 billion yuan, up 11.9 percent year-on-year, the bureau said.
